explication: Lantern is a cross-platform censorship-circumvention client. The main workflow is a user request through a platform client, into its VPN/tunnel implementation and the shared Go functionality that supports tunneling and related services. The tree also shows app selection, private-server, logging, update-relay, and iOS widget capabilities. Source evidence is uneven: several platform components and Go modules are indexed but not excerpted, so their unverified connections are omitted or shown as dashed.
